answer.text: The number-plate light is an LED unit, so there is no bulb to buy.
If it fails, the manual says the entire tail lamp/trafficator and licence plate illuminator assembly should be replaced.
Contact a Royal Enfield Authorised Dealer/Service Centre to replace it.

watchouts.text: Using bulbs or electrical gadgets other than the specified rating can overload the electrical system, cause erratic behaviour and lead to premature failure.

watchout_review.reason: Relevant to buying a replacement bulb or part.
